A '''zero-gee dancitorium''' was a form of popular entertainment on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bescane/Legends|Bescane]]. They were unique in that they operated in zero [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]], giving the dancer a novel experience. It was one of the many forms of entertainment present in [[Lumchugger's Hub]].<ref name="DH">{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}}</ref>
